decision.reason: The live provider HTTP surface is small and already shares Laravel's first-party PendingRequest/fake/retry primitives. Adding Saloon before additional provider breadth would introduce a parallel connector/request abstraction without retiring enough custom surface to produce a positive net reduction.
revisit_when: three or more materially distinct provider transports repeat request/auth/retry/test plumbing
provider connector fixtures or request recording become a recurring maintenance burden
a new provider tranche can remove more custom transport code than the Saloon integration adds
